summary: FreeSWITCH is an open-source communications platform designed to handle cross-platform telephony routing and signaling. Written in C under the MPL-2.0 licence, it provides the core infrastructure required to build voice, video and messaging applications. You can use it to manage SIP sessions, route audio streams, and build custom interactive voice response systems.
goodFor: It suits developers and systems administrators building carrier-grade voice applications or custom private branch exchange setups from scratch.
watchOut: Telephony software of this nature carries a steep configuration curve and debugging SIP routing issues can become exceptionally complex in production.
deployNotes: As a compiled C application, it typically runs as a dedicated system service with local configuration files, though you may need external database integration for complex multi-tenant call routing.
